summary.en: A star flash blinks at one point and a card is thrown out of it, spinning about its diagonal along an arc toward the camera; it stops dead face-on and a pulse rings out from its edge.
summary.zh: 一点星芒闪现，一张卡从光里被甩出：沿对角线自旋、走弧线飞向镜头，自旋随靠近衰减，到位硬定格正面朝前，卡边扩出一圈光脉冲。

fits: Producing the one hero object of an opening out of nothing: a product card, a cover, an invitation; dark grounds.
notFor: Several cards (it is a single production); light grounds where the flash does not read; informational cards read in motion.

overlaps.note: a card flung in from the side in fish-eye perspective that snaps flat; card-conjure produces it from a flash point, spinning toward the camera
a card drops from near the camera onto its place with an impact; card-conjure arrives from deep and stops without impact

intent.en: Make the one hero card feel conjured out of nothing: a flash marks where to look, the card is thrown from it and stops dead face-on, a magician's production that gives the object ceremony.
intent.zh: 让唯一的主角卡像被变出来：一道闪光先告诉观众看哪里，卡从光里被甩出、硬定格正对镜头，魔术师式的登场给这个物件仪式感。

content.en: One card face (a product card, a cover, an invitation) painted at 380 × 540 design size; its content is read only after the stop. No text of its own.
content.zh: 一张卡面（产品卡、封面、邀请函），按 380 × 540 的设计尺寸绘制；内容在定格后才读。积木本身不带文字。

fits.zh: 片头凭空变出唯一的主角物件：产品卡、封面、邀请函；暗底。

notFor.zh: 多张卡（这是一次只变一张的仪式）；闪光读不出来的浅色底；要在运动中读内容的信息卡。

pairs.note: a gloss across the card 8 frames after the stop

en: Keep the stop dead, with no rebound or slow tail; a bounce turns control into physics.
Render the flash outside any motion blur; blurred thin beams split into striped ghosts and look cheap.
One card per production; for several cards use a deal or a flip scene.
zh: 定格要硬，不回弹、不拖减速尾巴；一弹就从“掌控”变成了“物理”。
闪光层不要进运动模糊；细光束被模糊采样会拆成条纹分身，显廉价。
一次只变一张；多张卡用发牌或翻牌场景。

upstream.name: 魔术卡弹射
upstream.summary: 午夜蓝暗场上蓝色星芒闪现 0.3s（X 形针状光束旋转 90°+中心辉光放射小光芒），卡片从闪光点弹射而出——极速自旋弧线飞向镜头、自旋随靠近衰减、瞬间硬定格（卡高 86% 画高）、光脉冲 + sheen 扫光，右侧文案随后逐行揭示
upstream.use: 单张卡片/海报/封面的魔术性登场（片头主视觉、产品卡揭晓）；纯黑暗场；需要"变出来"仪式感的爆点
upstream.energy: 高（一次性爆点，定格后即静）
